sources.name: JLS 21 §9.8 Functional Interfaces
sources.quote: A functional interface is an interface that is not declared sealed and has just one abstract method (aside from the methods of Object).

sources.name: JLS 21 §15.27.2 Lambda Body
sources.quote: The meaning of names and the this and super keywords appearing in a lambda body ... are the same as in the surrounding context.

sources.name: JLS 21 §15.27.4 Lambda Evaluation
sources.quote: The identity of the result of evaluating a lambda expression is unpredictable.

sources.name: Java SE 21 FunctionalInterface API
sources.quote: An informative annotation type used to indicate that an interface type declaration is intended to be a functional interface.

sources.name: Java SE 21 java.util.function package API
sources.quote: The java.util.function package contains general purpose functional interfaces.

sources.name: Java SE 21 Consumer API
sources.quote: A functional interface whose functional method is accept(Object).

sources.name: Java SE 21 Supplier API
sources.quote: A functional interface whose functional method is get().
